invariants.rationale: The method immediately reads tiledColor.length(); tiledColor must not be null.
The code assumes the color string is in #RRGGBB (7) or #AARRGGBB (9) format.
Per the comment and usage, tiledColor should start with '#'.
Tiled color string should have 6 or 8 hex digits after '#'.
If length is 9, substring(1,3) (alpha) should be two hex digits.
